name: Kayden
source: Nova’s right hand. Always there when there’s something that needs fixing—cleaning up the bodies, silencing people, or making them disappear. He seems like a ruthless jerk, but he wasn’t always like that. If anything, he’s the best example of the corrupting influence of vampires. When you serve them long enough, you become like them, just without the perk of immortality.
